Field work

Jul 2026 – PresentNatural gas

Gas Planning & Optimization

PT Perusahaan Gas Negara Tbk · Integrated and Optimization Gas Management (IOGM) · Junior Analyst Intern

  • Diagnosed the root causes of off-spec CO2 days at city gates using daily gas quality data.
  • Forecasted pipeline supply and gas demand from 78 months of data, comparing 13 methods with rolling-origin evaluation and an ex-post test.
  • Built a supply–demand balance to project LNG substitution needs and the FSRU regasification trains required.
  • Calibrated a transmission network model in PIPELINE Studio and ran 30 steady-state runs and 1 transient run to test GHV, CO2, Wobbe Index, and pressure.
  • Set minimum LNG send-out limits and wrote 8 operational recommendations for gas planning.

Aug 2025 – May 2026Fuel products

Teaching Assistant

Politeknik Energi dan Mineral (PEM) Akamigas

  • Custody Transfer & Losses Management (Feb – May 2026): taught ship-to-shore quantity calculation, from draft, trim, and heel corrections and ullage readings to density and temperature correction, TOV to metric tons, and loss analysis.
  • Oil & Gas Product Sampling and Dipping (Aug – Nov 2025): instructed 62 students in dipping and sampling for storage tanks and tankers, using tank calibration and ASTM tables.
  • Evaluated practicum reports on custody documents such as Bills of Lading and ullage reports, and ran pre- and post-tests.

Dec 2025 – Jan 2026Fuel (BBM)LPG

Receiving, Storage & Distribution

PT Pertamina Patra Niaga · Integrated Terminal Cilacap · Junior Analyst Intern

  • Analyzed receiving, storage, and distribution at a 41,500 KL terminal supplied by pipeline from RU IV Cilacap.
  • Evaluated six months of B40 biodiesel deliveries to 8 fuel stations under the KL×km transport tariff (12 cost components).
  • Showed that serving those stations from IT Cilacap instead of FT Maos meant 129 km less total distance and a 58% lower September transport tariff.
  • Routed new products (Pertalite, Pertamax, Pertamax Turbo) for 14 stations with the Saving Matrix method, cutting total distance from 2,828 km to 1,802.5 km.
  • Used Fleet Management System data to review tank-truck routes and costs per delivery point.

Jun – Jul 2025LPG

Supply Chain Management

PT Heksa Energi Mitraniaga (Rukun Raharja Group) · LPG Terminal Rembang · Junior Analyst Intern

  • Supported LPG receiving at the jetty with the Loading Master, checking ship-shore safety checklists, Bills of Lading, and discharge calculations.
  • Ran temporary skid-tank distribution: inspection, tare and gross weighing, filling-shed loading, and valve sealing.
  • Compared distance, days of throughput (DOT), and transport, filling, and throughput fees for LPG filling stations across three Semarang-area supply points.
  • Designed four reallocation scenarios that rebalance DOT between supply points; the highest-gain scenario moved 6 stations to more cost-efficient supply points.

Research

Applied studies on fuel terminal design and product quality.

Capstone design & conference paperJun 2026

Pertamax supply chain for a new fuel terminal in Purbalingga

Team of three. We sited a new fuel terminal with Center of Gravity, buffer, and coverage-radius analysis in QGIS, routed tank-truck deliveries to 56 fuel stations with Dijkstra’s shortest path, and forecast 2026 Pertamax demand with SARIMAX (MAPE 6.01%).

Lead author · submitted to SNTEM 2026
